title: Nine Legs of Summer
subtitle: 昆虫与虫子 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 昆虫与虫子（自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：昆虫与虫子（自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：bug　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bug 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 my mother was sent to name ① a bug she could not catch, and she said the catching was the whole of the lesson. The ② bug, meaning the insect and not the fault, was nine legs long in the drawing and was kept by whoever came last; a bug, she said, is the only thing in a jar that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ bug in that jar had the same label, and the ④ bug at the front, meaning the one the boy kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever drew properly. A bug, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bug was the whole of the summer, meaning the fault it stood for and not the insect. The ⑥ bug, meaning the fault and not any of that, is the only thing in a machine that everybody blames and nobody questions; a bug, he said, is either something you name or the only word that means both an insect and a fault. She said the fault is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ bug had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the label. The ⑧ bug of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine legs and eleven years of naming; a bug, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ bug I remember is the one at the front, which was drawn in 1976 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ bug, my grandmother said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being named; every bug, she said, is a fault that has agreed to look like an insect. She said the fault was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 虫子（指那只虫本身，与故障相对）
C. 固定搭配：name a bug 说出一只虫子的名字
D. n. 虫子（指罐子里每一只）
E. n. 虫子（指前面那一只）
F. n. 故障；毛病（抽象：与虫子相对）
G. n. 那个毛病（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bug she could not catch
The bug, meaning the insect and not the fault
bug was the whole of the summer
the bug had become a photograph in a report
The bug of the whole thing
A bug, my grandmother said in 1983

answers.why: name a bug 意为“说出一只虫子的名字”，1955 年母亲被派去说出一只她捉不到的虫子的名字。
bug 意为“虫子”，指那只虫本身而不是故障，画上数出九条腿，由最后走的人养着。
bug 指罐子里每一只虫，每一只都是同样的标签。
bug 指前面那一只（男孩留的那一只），是唯一有人认真画过的。
bug 意为“故障、毛病”，与虫子相对，父亲说 bug 就是那个夏天的全部。
bug 为抽象用法，指那个毛病本身，是机器里人人都怪、却没人质疑的东西。
bug 意为“昆虫、小虫”，到 1971 年这只 bug 成了报告里的一张照片。
bug 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九条腿和十一年的命名。
bug 意为“虫子”，我记得的是前面那一只，1976 年被画下来，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
bug 为抽象总称，祖母说虫子是唯一会因为被叫出名字而变好的东西。
